title: caltha palustris var. parnassifolia
intro: Caltha palustris var. parnassifolia, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Asia. The Marsh Marigold has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The Marsh Marigold has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections, with its therapeutic actions believed to include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
